description.en: Hold the knife, push, blow the dust away

howToPlay.zh: 照着篆刻师傅的工序刻一方四字印：先倒边，再刻边框、刻十字分成四格，最后一笔一笔刻字。在屏幕上拖动就是移刀，刀尖在手指上方跟着走；把刀尖放到稿线的一端，点底部的「下刀」，刀压进石头，这时在屏幕任意位置顺着线划就是刻：竖线往上划，横线往左或往右划，刀从停下的地方一顿一顿地吃进去，往回划会顺着刻过的槽退回。抬起手指刀留在石头里，再划一次接着刻；点「提刀」回到移刀。‹ › 转动印石，换个顺手的角度。手一偏、刻过头，刀痕都会如实留在印上，不会刻坏。刻完按「吹」把石粉吹干净，印石转一圈展示，印蜕收进右上角的「印谱」，同时解锁下一方；「重刻」可以把这一方从头再来。印面上刻的是反字，盖出来才是正的。电脑上：鼠标移动或拖动是移刀，下刀后按住左键顺着线拖就是刻。键盘：方向键移刀，空格下刀或提刀，下刀后按上或左右方向键顺着线推、反方向往回拉，Q 和 E 转动印石，B 吹粉，A 打开印谱。
howToPlay.en: Carve a four-character seal the way a seal carver does: chamfer the face's edges, cut the border, cut a cross into four cells, then carve the characters stroke by stroke. Dragging moves the knife, its tip just above your finger. Set the tip at one end of a draft line and press Cut at the bottom: the knife goes into the stone, and now a swipe anywhere on the screen carves along the line, up for upright lines, left or right for lines across. The knife bites in from where it stands, flake by flake, and swiping back slides it down its own groove. Lifting your finger leaves the knife in the stone for the next swipe; press Lift to move it again. ‹ › turn the stone to a comfortable angle. Wobbles and overruns stay in the stone as they were cut, but nothing can be ruined. When all is cut, Blow clears the powder, the stone turns once, and the print goes into Seals (top right) and the next seal opens; Redo starts the seal on the bench over. The face is carved mirrored so that it prints the right way round. With a mouse: move or drag to move the knife; with it in, hold the button and drag along a line to carve. Keyboard: arrow keys move the knife, Space puts it in or lifts it; with it in, Up, Left or Right pushes along a line and the opposite key pulls back; Q and E turn the stone, B blows, A opens your seals.
